crossRefs.note: The high priest stood up, and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?”
Pilate answered, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?”

parallels.note: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”

people.name: Pilate
people.line: Roman governor who presided over Jesus' trial

translations.web: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”
translations.bsb: Then Pilate asked Him, “Do You not hear how many charges they are bringing against You?”
translations.kjv: Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?
translations.asv: Then saith Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?
